messages:
Marta: seeing a spike of 429s from eu-west GPU pools around 12:03 UTC. ~10% of requests returning 429 with admit headers. X-Redwood-Queue-Length is climbing. Anyone else noticing this?

teo: yep, I see the same in runtime metrics. load spiked after the checkout service deploy, autoscaler lagged.

sophia: infra-bot shows node flaps + a couple OOM evictions in eu-west-3 starting 12:01. could be compounding.

infra-bot: [alert] pool=eu-west-3 nodes_unavailable=3 current_util=96% admit_rate=0.64 avg_queue_ms=42

sam: quick thought: we should standardize the headers we return so clients can react. propose: `X-Redwood-Admit: <0..1 float>`, `X-Redwood-Queue: <int len>`, `X-Redwood-Estimate-Delay-ms: <int>` for guidance.

elena: +1 on stable names. devex needs canonical header names and clear client-side defaults (retry/backoff/jitter). We'll add examples to the SDKs.

Marta: question — do we want to emit "soft" 429s with admit headers (retryable) vs hard failures (503)?

teo: prefer soft 429 when admission < 0.8 so clients can retry with backoff. If header absent or admit==0 treat as terminal for that request.

oncall: quick mitigation: routing heavy model traffic to a dedicated secondary pool for the next 10m. rolling rollback of the offending deploy in progress. will update. :white_check_mark:

sophia: also seeing imbalance across shards — scheduler is packing too tightly by container age. I'll push a spread-by-model-hash fix that should reduce tail saturation.

elena: can we include a tiny compact alias for low-bandwidth clients (mobile/edge)? e.g. `X-RW-A:0.72` as a short form.

sam: okay to add an alias but keep the canonical names for docs/APIs. SDKs should accept both.

teo: sample guidance for clients: `if X-Redwood-Admit < 0.75 or X-Redwood-Estimate-Delay-ms > 100 then exponential-backoff with jitter`. Example pseudo: ```
base = 100ms
if admit < 0.75:
  delay = min(30000ms, base * (1.5 ** attempts)) + jitter(0, base*0.1)
sleep(delay)
```

Marta: infra — can we emit admit as a compact 0..255 byte (instead of float) for really constrained headers and still map in docs?

sophia: we can add a byte-encoded alias `X-RW-A-B` but it adds parsing complexity. prefer string float + short alias for now.

infra-bot: deploy event: scheduler v1.14 rollback started by @oncall at 12:10 UTC

Marta: thanks everyone. I'll open a tiny RFC with header names, precise semantics for soft 429, and a PR to update SDK retry logic to honor admit + estimate-delay.

elena: I'll draft the SDK examples (Go/TS/Python) and default retry windows for mobile vs server side.

oncall: monitoring note: set temporary alert on admit_rate < 0.7 across any pool to trigger paging.

sam: agreed. also let's add a tracing tag so we can correlate client retries to admit signals later.

Marta: filing follow-ups: RFC (#), SDK PR (#), docs PR (#). Will ping once drafts exist. Thanks :pray:
